label: US dental chain: booking app (HIPAA)
brief:
Subject: Quote request - patient booking app

Hi Empower team,

We run 14 dental clinics across Ohio and Michigan (BrightSmile Dental Group). Right now patients call the front desk to book, and our staff spend most of the morning on the phone. We want:

1. A patient app (iPhone + Android) and a matching website where patients can book, reschedule and cancel cleanings and appointments with a specific dentist or hygienist.
2. SMS and email reminders 48h and 2h before the visit, with a 'confirm' button. No-shows cost us a lot.
3. Patients should see their upcoming visits, past visit summaries and outstanding balance, and pay the balance by card.
4. A simple admin panel for front-desk staff to manage dentist schedules, block holidays and see the day's bookings per clinic.
5. Our practice management system is Dentrix; bookings need to sync with it (they have an API, we think).

We obviously need this to be HIPAA compliant. We'd like to go live before our busy season in early April. Budget is not fixed but our board was thinking around $60-80k. Can you send a proposal with timeline and price?

Thanks,
Megan Walsh
COO, BrightSmile Dental Group

label: German manufacturer: predictive maintenance (EU)
brief:
Dear Empower Solutions,

Hoffmann Antriebstechnik GmbH builds industrial gearboxes in Stuttgart. We have ~220 CNC machines across two plants, each with vibration and temperature sensors that already push data to an MQTT broker every 5 seconds.

We are looking for a partner to build:
- A data pipeline that stores the sensor data (we estimate ~3 years of history needs to be kept)
- A web dashboard for plant managers: live machine status, alarms, OEE KPIs per line and shift
- A predictive maintenance model that warns 3-7 days before a spindle bearing fails. We have about 2 years of labelled failure records in Excel.
- Alerts by e-mail and Microsoft Teams
- Integration with our SAP PM module to create maintenance orders automatically

All data must stay in the EU (we use Azure, West Europe). The UI must be available in German and English. Our works council needs to approve anything that could monitor employees, so the system must not track individual operators.

Please share feasibility, approach, team and an indicative fixed price. Target start: January 2027.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen,
Dr. Katrin Hoffmann
Head of Digital Operations

label: UK startup: savings app MVP in 10 weeks
brief:
Hey!

We're Pocketful, a pre-seed fintech in London. We want an MVP of a round-up savings app: users link their bank account (Open Banking via TrueLayer), every card purchase is rounded up to the nearest pound and the change is moved into a savings pot. Users can set goals, see progress, and withdraw.

Must-haves for MVP: iOS + Android app, onboarding with KYC (we'll use Onfido), TrueLayer integration, goals, a simple admin view for us, push notifications. Nice-to-have: an AI 'money coach' chat that gives savings tips.

We have a demo day with investors in 10 weeks so we need it live on TestFlight by then. Our budget is GBP 25k max, we can't go above that. Is this doable?

Cheers,
Sam Okafor, Co-founder
